name: Michaela Reindlová
bio: As an Office Coordinator at HiBob, she looks after the office and the people in it.
bio_long: Michaela is originally from the Czech Republic but now calls Amsterdam home. As an Office Coordinator at HiBob, she looks after the office and the people in it, from operations and employee experience to wellbeing, events, vendors, budgets and new joiners.

name: Lina Maria Arenas
bio: Originally Colombian, she is an Office Manager at Santen. She focuses most on creating a workplace where people feel supported, connected, and able to do their best work.
bio_long: I’m Lina, an Office Manager based in Amsterdam, responsible for workplace operations, employee experience, events, wellbeing initiatives, and internal services. My role is very cross-functional, so I work closely with different teams, leadership, and external partners to make sure the office runs smoothly while creating a positive experience for everyone. I’m especially passionate about building a strong workplace culture where people feel welcome, connected, and supported. I also enjoy finding ways to improve how we work, making our workplace more efficient, engaging, and sustainable.
